findings.title: worker:lost rose and the R19 no-lost check fails again (13 -> 11 of 15)
findings.detail: 5 workers were lost in 4 runs, all on doy 19-22. The round's own paired arm shows the same rise (runs with a loss went 2 -> 4), so the round-12 tree causes it. The probe on pp #1's cached hand-over shows both lost workers entering forage.return / tend.return at the same tick (gd 12.36). Neither changed state again until RETURN_LOST_S, 2 gd later. Neither was ever held by the flood hold or handed back by it (0 and 0), so D32 is not the mechanism. What changed is that more workers are outside late in the season (forage 516 -> 607 worker game days). Why a homing worker makes no progress for 2 gd was not traced.

findings.title: we #3 viable -> NOT viable: goes into winter without its carbohydrate
findings.detail: R27 stores C 1.07 of 6.16 (sweep 11: 11.0). It never found a herd (one 160 BU out, nearest approach 60 BU). From doy 15 to winter C fell 7.1 -> 1.1 while P rose 4.4 -> 6.4: foragers brought 1.6-2.8 P a day against 0.1-0.5 C, with C under R35's winter path the whole time. R39 is not involved (no herd, tend 0). It made 14 C forage trips against 29 in sweep 11, and found no nectar. C intake fell by more than 0.1 in 7 of 15 runs; median C 1.441 -> 1.296.

findings.title: Two of the round's four hygiene tests (hygiene26 cases 1 and 3) pass on the base tree
findings.detail: Case 1 (8 meconium items, the hauler away) and case 3 (a film does not hold) pass unchanged on c2ed6cb. A probe found 8 items clear in 600 ticks on both trees; 16 items clear in 1050-1100 ticks on the round's tree and in 1450-2150 on the base. I added two tests that are green on the round's tree and red on the base. hold26.verify measures 0 < depth < FLEE_WATER_DEPTH_BU over the destination with the hold's own reader and requires no hold (the base held at 4 of 4 checks). burst26.verify requires 16 items under tolerance within 1250 ticks on seeds 5 and 6 (base: 2150).

findings.title: The freed tenders did not all reach forage: idle worker time doubled
findings.detail: Idle went 137 -> 257 worker game days in the sweep and 136 -> 278 in the round's own arm (tend -269, forage +112). That contradicts the round's 'nobody is idle' reading from 3 gd on two colonies. Over 8 gd on pp #2, most idle hours fall at the end of the season, when nothing is wanted. But on day 4, 3-5 of 20 workers were idle while P want was 4.3 and the forage demand of 7 was fully staffed (cap 31). The forage demand, sized by yieldPerForager (0.96-1.27), asks for fewer foragers than the realised yield (0.6-1.2) needs.

findings.title: kd #2: larvae starve with protein in store while the nurse target is understaffed
findings.detail: In hours 51-65 the nurse demand was 7-10 and the target 5, but only 2 nursed while 2-3 workers were idle. 6 larvae starved on doy 13 with P 1.5 and C 12 in store. Hours with target - nursing >= 2 and an idle worker: 0 in sweep 11, 13 here (9 of them kd #2).

findings.title: scoutSmellReport case 3 bypasses phaseScout's timeout wiring
findings.detail: It calls rememberSmelled directly, so it would not fail if updateInvestigate stopped calling it.
